newsitem.title: THAILAND: S.Korea to allow foreign rating of local bonds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to allow foreign rating of local bonds.

text.p: South Korean authorities will allow foreign rating agencies to rate domestic bond issues later this year, the managing director of Seoul Investment Trust Management Co Ltd, said on Tuesday.

"Entry barriers to the credit rating industry are to be abolished in September 1997, leading to greater competition and improved quality of South Korea's credit rating system," Insup Lee told an Asian Bonds conference.
